headline: Khaitan & Co, TT&A, JSA act on Nobel Hygiene ₹150 crore+ proposed IPO
sum: Nobel Hygiene Limited has proposed an initial public offering of equity shares comprising a fresh issue amounting to ₹150 crore and offer for sale of up to 15,511,082 Equity Shares by the selling shareholders. Khaitan & Co is advising…
detail: Nobel Hygiene Limited has proposed an initial public offering of equity shares comprising a fresh issue amounting to ₹150 crore and offer for sale of up to 15,511,082 Equity Shares by the selling shareholders. Khaitan & Co is advising Nobel Hygiene on this IPO. TT&A is advising selling shareholders Orbit Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd.
